Senses.Explanation: The melting-like-ice of the Chan records: the total dissolution — the grief-thought and the gates with it, the doubt-mass broken, the senses smelted in the furnace, the snow-mountain years, the earth at the founder's blow, and the old man's doted last word. Lingji Xingguan answers the post-retreat ask — before the retreat opened, every air was kinglike; after the seven-day rounds, why has every one of them melted like ice and crumbled like tiles? How would you get here? — and for the cold-ash bean-burst arrival: just look where the melting happens, Shiqi Tongyun writes the mourning layman: know where the love-thought arises and that very thought melts — the buddhas' wondrous meanings and the hundred thousand gates melt with it, and the standing place melts of itself, Yingshan Zhiyin's hesitation essay walks the midway road — fire-pit ahead, wolves and tigers behind, knives on the left and thorns on the right — till, like Lingyun at the peach blossoms, the doubt-mass breaks and no karma-delusion stays unmelted, this time reaching the ground of no doubt, and Jieweizhou Xingzhou opens and closes the retreat: at the binding the six senses are tied into one bundle and thrown into the great furnace, forged morning and evening till the ice melts and the tiles crumble; at the loosening the eighty-four thousand pores spring open, lights and wonders raining their flowers. Fangrong Ruxi judges the birthday scene — one cry at birth: heaven above, heaven below, I alone am honored; six snow-mountain years melted like ice; all beings hold the thus-come's wisdom — and rules that neither reading has scratched the sage's itch, Yunsou Benzhu stages the founder on the whisk-tip pointing sky and earth, struck by Yunmen's sudden blow: the earth and mountains melt, the myriad forms' eyes spring open — and he re-issues the order himself, and Huigong Kaixiong comments on the Dongyuan record: a pinch on the knee or a roar of laughter, and the order would have melted at once — even the Shouchang master's last word, doting father that he was, but love not noticing its own ugliness.
